title: AUDIO row still not persisted: settings_save_app saves on every adjust but A11y_Settings has no mute byte (SETTINGS_VERSION still 1)
evidence: app/main.odin: 'case rnd.SETTINGS_ROW_AUDIO: au.toggle_mute(&app.audio) }' then 'settings_save_app(app)'; app/settings.odin: 'A11y_Settings :: struct { palette: rnd.Palette_Mode, reduced_motion: bool, scale_step: u8 }' and 'SETTINGS_VERSION :: u8(1)'; settings_save_at: 'buf[2] = u8(s.palette); buf[3] = 1 if s.reduced_motion else 0; buf[4] = s.scale_step' — no mute byte.
detail: The audio row routes through the persist call yet persists nothing; mute resets on relaunch. The new settings_adjust_audio_effect test also asserts state only, not persistence — consistent but unruled.
recommended_fix: Persist the mute byte (bump SETTINGS_VERSION, defaults on mismatch), or document the non-goal in the spec and drop settings_save_app from the audio path.

title: Harness capture still computes crisis banner_y from raw constants while the app hud-scales it
evidence: banner_y: i32 = 10 / banner_y = 10 + rnd.HEALTH_CARD_H + 6 / rnd.draw_crisis_banner(&rc.view, crisis, rc.view.catalogs, era, banner_y)
detail: The a11y_scale (x1.50) T2 golden pins the banner at an unscaled y, so the golden under-specifies the app's scaled banner placement — a divergence trap between harness and app geometry.
recommended_fix: Route the capture banner_y through rnd.hud(&rc.view, ...) (and the card height) so the scale golden reflects the real draw.

title: Compiled Python bytecode still tracked: tools/__pycache__/derive_a11y_palettes.cpython-313.pyc
detail: Build artifact committed to the tree alongside the derivation script it shadows.
recommended_fix: git rm --cached the .pyc and add __pycache__/ to .gitignore.

title: Exec-level adjust tests call rnd.palette_load() without teardown, adding tracking-allocator leak reports to the app test binary
evidence: adjust_test_app: 'app.palette_base = rnd.palette_load() / app.palette = app.palette_base / app.view.palette = &app.palette' — no palette destroy; odin test app output shows many '+++ leak ... [palette.odin:148:palette_load()]' lines (pre-existing at r6: 438 leak lines; the new tests add more).
detail: Tests still report 'All tests were successful' so no CI bite, but the report grows with each new exec test that loads the palette.
recommended_fix: Add a palette destroy (or a shared test fixture palette) in adjust_test_app.
